won_reason: Procurement and legal engaged early, smooth approval process, closed in 75 days

calls.notes: Excellent discovery call. Rohan has a strong pain around test automation — 40% of deployments failing QA. CTO Kavita joined the last 15 minutes. We asked directly: who else needs to approve this? She mentioned procurement team and legal. We asked for their names and timelines immediately.

Sent custom ROI calculator showing 60% reduction in QA failures within 90 days. Rohan loved it. More importantly, we sent our standard vendor contract to their procurement contact Deepa proactively — before she even asked. Kavita was impressed by our process maturity.

Call with Kavita, Rohan, and Deepa from procurement. Deepa had already reviewed our contract and had only 2 minor questions. We resolved them live on the call. Legal review was fast because we had sent pre-approved contract language. Kavita asked about annual prepay discount.

Addressed CircleCI comparison directly — sent a one-page feature comparison doc showing 3 differentiators. Kavita appreciated the transparency. Offered 12% discount for annual prepay. She said she would check with CFO.
WON. CFO approved the annual prepay. Contract signed. Kavita said our procurement readiness and ROI calculator were the two things that made this decision easy.

lessons_learned: Ask about procurement and legal in Call 1 — every time
Send vendor contract proactively before procurement asks
Custom ROI calculator is a deal accelerator — build it for every deal above $50k
Annual prepay offer works better when paired with concrete ROI data
Address competitor comparisons head-on with a clean one-page doc
